findings.evidence: “A C4 view is a model of deployable units, ownership boundaries and runtime dependencies” introduces familiar C4 concepts. The 64-line Workflow section also includes standard reminders such as “External systems are black boxes” and “Keep aliases and names identical across views”; the 11-line NEVER section supplies substantially more distinctive Mermaid-specific knowledge.
findings.fix: Remove the introductory definition and consolidate elementary abstraction, external-system and naming reminders into a compact model-check checklist. Preserve the evidence-to-element mapping, environment reconciliation, boundary decision criteria and Mermaid-specific failure rules.

findings.evidence: The fallback command uses “npx -y -p @mermaid-js/mermaid-cli mmdc” without a version, while references/c4-syntax.md identifies mermaid-cli 11.17 as the renderer used for its examples. This fallback can therefore silently use a different parser and rendering behavior.
findings.fix: Pin the fallback to the exact CLI version used to validate the examples, for example `npx -y -p @mermaid-js/mermaid-cli@11.17.0 mmdc -i <file> -o <tmp>/out.md`, and recommend that pinned invocation when an installed mmdc has incompatible syntax support.
